questions.prompt: An exam counts 70% and a project 30%. A student scores 80 in the exam and 90 in the project. What is the weighted mark?
Data from 42 to 97 is grouped in classes of width 10 starting at 40. How many classes are needed?
A histogram of the heights of a class has one tall peak in the middle and short bars at each end. Describe what this tells you about the heights.
questions.modelAnswer: Most students have heights in the middle classes, around a typical value; fewer students are very short or very tall. The distribution is roughly symmetrical, so the mean, median and mode will be close together near the peak.
